en.answer:
In either case they will be negated.

This is the same for <<21623>> and <<6481>>, and for the monster effects of <<19172>> and <<12953>>.
en.question:
During a turn in which, and during the next turn after, a <<22127>> was banished due to the effect of <<13619>>, will the activated effect of <<15245>> be negated?

Also, during a turn in which, and during the next turn after, a <<15245>> was banished due to the effect of <<13619>>, will the activated effects of <<22127>> be negated?
en.title: If <<22127>> is banished with the effect of <<13619>>, will the effect of <<15245>> be negated?

ja.answer:
どちらの場合でも無効化されます。

「<<21623>>」と「<<6481>>」の場合や、「<<19172>>」と「<<12953>>」のモンスター効果の場合も同様です。
